baseline.scenario_text: A newly appointed Assistant Section Officer receives an official file requiring urgent approval from the Joint Secretary.
baseline.question: [Level 1 - Foundational] Under CSMOP guidelines, what is the mandatory format for submitting a draft for approval on an e-Office note sheet?
options: Draft for Approval (DFA) linked to the main note sheet with clear paragraph numbering
Informal hand-written note submitted without a file number
Direct email without recording on the e-Office system
Oral briefing without filing any written draft

distractor_explanations.1: Informal notes violate CSMOP Secretariat guidelines.
distractor_explanations.2: Emails are non-compliant without e-Office file indexing.
distractor_explanations.3: Oral briefings are legally invalid without written record.

baseline.scenario_text: During an NSO regional office audit, an officer observes that policy decisions are being recorded in routine correspondence files rather than Classified Policy Files.
baseline.question: [Level 2 - Applied] Which corrective procedure should be initiated immediately under Central Secretariat Manual rules?
options: Re-classify the file, create a dedicated Policy File series, and cross-reference previous decisions
Ignore the procedural defect as decisions were already implemented
Delete previous decision entries from file records
Transfer all files to external personal storage

distractor_explanations.1: Ignoring procedural defects creates legal vulnerabilities.
distractor_explanations.2: Deleting entries constitutes tampering with official records.
distractor_explanations.3: External storage breaches government security protocol.

baseline.scenario_text: A Senior Statistical Officer is offered an honorarium by a private university for delivering a guest lecture series on official NSO survey data methodologies.
baseline.question: [Level 3 - Advanced] Under CCS (Conduct) Rules 1964, Rule 15, what specific prior sanction is required before accepting the honorarium?
options: Prior written sanction from the Competent Authority confirming no conflict of interest
No sanction required if delivered outside office hours
Oral permission from an immediate colleague
Post-facto notification submitted after 6 months

distractor_explanations.1: CCS Conduct Rule 15 mandates prior written sanction regardless of hours.
distractor_explanations.2: Colleague permission carries zero legal validity.
distractor_explanations.3: Post-facto notification is invalid for financial honorarium.

intermediate.scenario_text: An RTI applicant requests raw microdata of a sensitive household consumer expenditure survey before official publication.
intermediate.question: [Level 2 - Applied] Under RTI Act 2005 Section 8(1), on what legal ground can the Central Public Information Officer (CPIO) decline premature disclosure?
options: Section 8(1)(d) or (j) where premature release prejudices economic interest and statistical integrity
CPIO personal preference without citing statutory exemptions
Charging an arbitrary penalty fee to discourage the applicant
Refusing to acknowledge receipt of the RTI application

distractor_explanations.1: Personal preference is not a statutory exemption under RTI.
distractor_explanations.2: Arbitrary fees violate Section 7 fee rules.
distractor_explanations.3: Refusal to acknowledge triggers penalty under Section 20.

baseline.scenario_text: A government office intends to purchase IT hardware valued at Rs. 1,50,000.
baseline.question: [Level 1 - Foundational] Under GFR 2017 Rule 149, what is the mandatory procurement portal for Central Government Ministries?
options: Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
Local retail shop quotation without tender
Unregistered third-party vendor website
Cash purchase without receipt

distractor_explanations.1: GFR Rule 149 strictly mandates GeM procurement.
distractor_explanations.2: Unregistered websites violate financial rules.
distractor_explanations.3: Cash purchase above threshold violates GFR rules.

baseline.scenario_text: During GeM direct purchase exceeding Rs. 5,00,000, three L1 vendors offer identical pricing.
baseline.question: [Level 2 - Applied] Which mechanism must the buyer employ on GeM to determine the successful vendor transparently?
options: Run an automated GeM Reverse Auction (RA) or Direct L1 comparison tool
Select vendor manually based on personal preference
Cancel the entire procurement indefinitely
Split the contract into smaller packages to bypass thresholds

distractor_explanations.1: Manual selection violates GeM transparency guidelines.
distractor_explanations.2: Cancelling without reason disrupts official operations.
distractor_explanations.3: Splitting demand violates GFR Rule 157.

baseline.scenario_text: CAG Audit raises a Audit Para regarding non-recovery of unspent advance drawn for field survey operations 12 months ago.
baseline.question: [Level 3 - Advanced] According to DFPR and Treasury Rules, how should the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) settle the audit objection?
options: Recover outstanding advance with penal interest immediately and submit broadsheet reconciliation to Audit
Write off the amount without competent authority sanction
Adjust the unspent advance against unrelated future expenditure
Ignore CAG audit query until retirement

distractor_explanations.1: Writing off requires formal financial sanction.
distractor_explanations.2: Adjusting against future expenditure violates accounting rules.
distractor_explanations.3: Ignoring audit paras leads to PAC escalation.

intermediate.scenario_text: A department needs urgent repair of statistical survey vehicles.
intermediate.question: [Level 2 - Applied] What is the monetary limit for purchasing goods without quotation under GFR 2017 Rule 154?
options: Up to Rs. 25,000 on certificate basis
Up to Rs. 5,00,000 without certificate
Unlimited monetary authority
Zero - tenders required for all amounts

distractor_explanations.1: Rs. 5,00,000 threshold requires local purchase committee.
distractor_explanations.2: Unlimited authority does not exist.
distractor_explanations.3: Small value purchases are exempted under Rule 154.

baseline.scenario_text: An NSO field team is preparing a socio-economic survey across urban and rural sectors with unequal income variances.
baseline.question: [Level 1 - Foundational] Why is Stratified Random Sampling preferred over Simple Random Sampling (SRS) for national surveys?
options: It ensures representation across heterogenous sub-populations and reduces overall variance
It eliminates the need for a sampling frame
It guarantees 100% survey response rate without non-sampling error
It requires zero statistical calculation

distractor_explanations.1: Stratified sampling still requires a sampling frame per stratum.
distractor_explanations.2: Non-sampling errors can still occur during field collection.
distractor_explanations.3: Statistical calculations are necessary for weight assignment.

baseline.scenario_text: In a Probability Proportional to Size (PPS) survey, sampling units have varying selection probabilities $\pi_i$.
baseline.question: [Level 2 - Applied] Which formula represents the Horvitz-Thompson unbiased estimator for total population $Y$?
options: $\hat{Y}_{HT} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{y_i}{\pi_i}$
$\hat{Y} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i$
$\hat{Y} = \max(y_i) \times N$
$\hat{Y} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i \cdot \pi_i$

distractor_explanations.1: This is simple sample mean, biased under unequal probability sampling.
distractor_explanations.2: Max value multiplication is mathematically invalid.
distractor_explanations.3: Multiplying by selection probability instead of inverse weights gives incorrect total.

baseline.scenario_text: During data validation of a 50,000 household survey dataset, an auditor discovers unexpected zero values in household consumption expenditure fields.
baseline.question: [Level 3 - Advanced] What data auditing procedure should be executed in Excel / Python before publishing official statistical estimates?
options: Perform outlier detection, cross-verify with secondary schedules, and apply item-imputation protocols
Replace all zero values with the sample mean automatically without verification
Delete non-responding households from dataset without weighting adjustment
Falsify field schedules to show non-zero entries

distractor_explanations.1: Automatic replacement distorts distribution variance.
distractor_explanations.2: Deleting units without re-weighting introduces non-response bias.
distractor_explanations.3: Falsifying data is a severe disciplinary offense.

intermediate.scenario_text: An officer is analyzing CPI inflation data using MS Excel.
intermediate.question: [Level 2 - Applied] Which Excel function combination is most robust for dynamic 2D lookup of commodity price indices across months?
options: INDEX and MATCH combination
Basic VLOOKUP with hardcoded column index
CONCATENATE function
SUMIF without criteria range

distractor_explanations.1: Hardcoded VLOOKUP breaks if columns are inserted.
distractor_explanations.2: CONCATENATE only joins text strings.
distractor_explanations.3: SUMIF requires valid criteria ranges.

baseline.scenario_text: An officer initiates a digital file on e-Office.
baseline.question: [Level 1 - Foundational] What mandatory security feature validates an e-File approval on the e-Office portal?
options: Aadhaar e-Sign or Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)
Plain text name typed at the bottom of note
Scanned image of signature pasted on screen
No verification required

distractor_explanations.1: Plain text carries zero legal authenticity.
distractor_explanations.2: Pasted signature images are prone to forgery.
distractor_explanations.3: Unverified files cannot be legally processed.

baseline.scenario_text: A ministry is integrating its public portal with DigiLocker API.
baseline.question: [Level 2 - Applied] Which protocol ensures secure authorization between government portals and DigiLocker repositories?
options: OAuth 2.0 framework with encrypted REST APIs
Unencrypted HTTP GET requests
Sharing master database passwords over email
FTP file transfer without credentials

distractor_explanations.1: Unencrypted HTTP violates MeitY security guidelines.
distractor_explanations.2: Sharing database passwords violates IT security policy.
distractor_explanations.3: Uncredentialed FTP exposes sensitive data.

baseline.scenario_text: A department deploys an AI LLM model to automate public grievance classification.
baseline.question: [Level 3 - Advanced] Under MeitY AI Governance Guidelines, what mechanism must be implemented to prevent algorithmic bias?
options: Continuous Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) auditing and representative training dataset validation
Allowing AI model to auto-reject grievances without audit log
Disabling audit logging to save storage space
Using unvalidated web scraped data without preprocessing

distractor_explanations.1: Auto-rejection violates administrative natural justice.
distractor_explanations.2: Disabling logs prevents post-mortem compliance checks.
distractor_explanations.3: Unvalidated data causes hallucination and bias.

intermediate.scenario_text: An e-Office file requires multi-departmental concurrence.
intermediate.question: [Level 2 - Applied] What is the correct e-Office feature to route file copies simultaneously to multiple divisions?
options: Parallel Referencing / Inter-Departmental Migration
Deleting the file and re-creating it per division
Printing paper copies and posting by mail
Downloading file to local USB drive

distractor_explanations.1: Deleting files breaks audit trail.
distractor_explanations.2: Paper mail defeats paperless e-Office objective.
distractor_explanations.3: USB downloads violate endpoint security.

baseline.scenario_text: A team leader is managing a complex multi-district survey project.
baseline.question: [Level 1 - Foundational] Which key leadership practice ensures timely project delivery across dispersed teams?
options: Clear goal setting, milestone tracking, and regular feedback loops
Micro-managing every minor task without delegation
Avoiding communication until deadline expires
Assigning conflicting targets to team members

distractor_explanations.1: Micro-management lowers productivity and morale.
distractor_explanations.2: Avoiding communication causes project failure.
distractor_explanations.3: Conflicting targets create internal friction.

baseline.scenario_text: A major government infrastructure project faces critical path delays.
baseline.question: [Level 2 - Applied] In CPM / PERT project monitoring, what does a zero float activity represent?
options: A critical activity where any delay directly delays the overall project completion date
An activity that can be delayed indefinitely without impact
An optional task that can be omitted
A completed task requiring no monitoring

distractor_explanations.1: Activities with zero float cannot be delayed without delaying the project.
distractor_explanations.2: Zero float tasks are mandatory, not optional.
distractor_explanations.3: Completed tasks have no float status.

baseline.scenario_text: An administrator faces public pressure to fast-track an environmental clearance for a commercial project.
baseline.question: [Level 3 - Advanced] How should the officer balance administrative speed with public interest ethics?
options: Adhere strictly to statutory EIA evaluation parameters while ensuring transparent, time-bound processing
Bypass environmental impact study to appease stakeholders
Delay file indefinitely without providing official reasons
Outsource decision making to an unauthorized private consultant

distractor_explanations.1: Bypassing EIA rules causes environmental harm and legal invalidity.
distractor_explanations.2: Indefinite delay violates administrative timelines.
distractor_explanations.3: Delegating statutory authority to private consultants is illegal.

intermediate.scenario_text: A project manager is monitoring budget expenditure variance.
intermediate.question: [Level 2 - Applied] What metric in Earned Value Management (EVM) indicates a project is under budget?
options: Cost Variance (CV = EV - AC) > 0
Schedule Variance (SV) < 0
Cost Performance Index (CPI) < 0.5
Actual Cost exceeding Budgeted Cost

distractor_explanations.1: SV indicates schedule status, not cost.
distractor_explanations.2: CPI < 1 indicates over budget expenditure.
distractor_explanations.3: Actual exceeding Budget means over budget.
